description: React component for confirming and displaying details of various Mattermost integrations such as commands, webhooks, OAuth apps, OAuth connections, and bot accounts. It handles different integration types, displays tokens or URLs, and provides navigation and copy-to-clipboard features.

methods.name: ConfirmIntegration
methods.description: React functional component that displays confirmation details for various Mattermost integrations based on URL parameters and provided props.

methods.name: handleKeyPress
methods.description: Handles keypress events, specifically the Enter key to navigate back to the integrations list.
